title: Vishnu Puranam - 08 - Birth of Sri Krishna
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt: As the atrocities and demonic forces wreaked havoc on the earth, it is said Bhoomi-Devi was not able to handle it. To eliminate the growing inhumanity and to re-establish religious practices on the planet, Bhoomi-Devi is said to have taken the form of a cow and visited Brahma to help her. Brahma then summoned all the celestials, and together all of them went to the heavenly abode of Vaikuntham where Lord Vishnu was resting on his serpent recliner Adisesha.
